item.title: Development :: RE: [AI] New programming language MasterBASIC
item.description:
Author: wolf83
Subject: An opition about AI usage
Posted: Mon Nov 09, 2026 9:07 pm (GMT 0)

I understand that manual programming and using certain programming languages has its own aesthetics and nostalgia and the nostalgia is why we are here for. Also, code that we understand has a benefit. However, AI opens totally new possibilities in this community and only with AI many ideas and projects can be realistically finished. There are many projects and postings which people have started and then gave up on them due to lack of time, effort, expertise, and other limited resources. People just do not have sufficient time and persistence to realize or finish projects, or to go beyond basic prototypes, but with AI they could. Choosing the programming language, programming style, or hand-made code, quality of contributions are orthogonal topics to AI. For example, why can a person A not write hand-made code, if person B uses AI. Person A can make a good or bad contribution with hand-made code, person B can make a good or bad contribution with AI. These things are independent.

My personal recommendation is to support AI usage in this forum (not for competitions) and to think how to prepare good instructions for AI so it understands how to work with the hardware and instructions effectively and enable projects. This would enable also non-experts to realize their long time wishes, that no person will otherwise implement. I am a programmer, but I do not have the time to study the hardware and all the programming that would be necessary for project that I would like to implement or mod in existing games. I would be happy to see am extensive knowledge base (agent skill) for an AI agent so it could realize the things that I would like to implement for my Game Gear. Also I have been waiting here for some projects to be finished and it never happened in the end, so the argument is real.

This is just my opinion and recommendation.

item.title: Development :: RE: SMS Phantasy Star II
item.description:
Author: cireza
Posted: Mon Nov 09, 2026 5:41 pm (GMT 0)

Hello xfixium,

The demo has a great presentation, the visuals have a lot of contrast and volume.

I was wondering if you had planned, and how, the rest of the battle content. Meaning backgrounds and enemies. Specifically about color choices.

I can see that you have locked in 13 colors that have to be common between characters and enemies, which means all backgrounds will have to be implemented with these 13 colors. For merging purposes if I understand.

This leaves 3 possible variable slots : are you planning to change them dynamically to be able to add an original color in the background and/or ennemies ? Or will these be set in stone ?

Simply wondering this because of some color gradients used for some enemies or potential backgrounds, and how you are going to work around these. Making ReSeCom, I found out that colors between my monsters/characters and the background happened to clash pretty often, and as neither were underlined with black (for a more realistic approach) I often had to make specific palette swaps to be sure of having the best visibility. And this happened despite the fact that I was actually reserving dedicated colors for background (7) and others for the enemies (9).
